# Packages for habitat selection analysis

```{r habitat_pref_packages, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(pander)

# Define & load the packages
packages <- c("dplyr", "magrittr", "ggplot2", "lme4", "tidyr", "lubridate", "DHARMa", "data.table", "ggpubr",  "kableExtra", "ggridges", "corrplot", "pROC", "ggeffects", "glmmTMB", "brms", "MASS", "MCMCglmm", "igraph", "MasterBayes", "pheatmap", "nadiv") 

# Install packages not yet installed - change lib to library path
```
